data.title: DeepSeek's Peak-Hour Pricing Betrays Where Its Users Really Live, Calming US Fears of a China AI Takeover, Even As Alibaba's Qwen Models Bury Meta On Hugging Face
data.description: DeepSeek's surge windows fall between 09:00 and 16:00 Beijing time — a tell that most demand still sits inside Asian time zones.
data.author: Rohail Saleem
